decision: Beside, never between: the room never hinders, limits or removes a feature of the tools it works with. Its one plugin hook, SessionStart (commonroom#262), returns only added context.
Readable and replaceable: everything a model is told by the room comes from a plain file in commonroom/ways/.
The room knows no project: no room module holds a project's name, path or login in code or a string.

Code holds obligations and models hold none: the ledger invariants (commonroom/steward.py) run every housekeeping beat, their findings are kept in the ledger and the digest, and the fixable ones wake the director once.
Spend is tied to landing: runs with nothing landed trip the no-output breaker, and the room stops until it is reset.
The owner's own use comes first: an unknown usage reading is not free capacity, so the gate holds.
Code decides what runs and models do the work: a full dispatcher pass picks a job without calling a model.
Ways of working change on evidence, without touching the wiring.
Each subscription runs only on its owner's machine.

Handshake only: the room improves the human side, never the model. It carries what the owner wants and why, and never tells a model how to think or work. Missing: a test that the text is about the task, the record and the owner, never about method; and the desk does not yet record the kind of each owner statement.
Lightweight: metrics report director and auditor input-token and run-minute shares against optional project targets. Missing: a standing comparison with one session doing the same work.
